protocols.trackSitesHint: When you log a dose, pick where it went. The site that has rested longest is suggested.

notif.needsInstallIOS: On iPhone/iPad, notifications only work after adding {{appName}} to your Home Screen (iOS 16.4+). See Install below.
notif.denied: Notifications are blocked. Enable them for {{appName}} in your device settings to turn them back on.
notif.reliabilityNote: Reminders are delivered while {{appName}} is open or running in the background. If your phone has fully closed the app, a reminder can't arrive until you open it again — anything that came due then shows up on Home with one tap to log it.
notif.testFailed: Couldn't show a notification. Check your device's notification settings for {{appName}}.
notif.reliabilityNotePush: Reminders arrive even when the app is closed. Anything that came due while your phone was off or offline shows up on Home with one tap to log it.
notif.pushNote: To deliver reminders while the app is closed, your device's anonymous push address and the times of your upcoming reminders are sent to our server. Compound names and doses never leave your device.

install.title: Install
install.available: Install {{appName}} for offline use and reliable notifications.
install.iosInstructions: In Safari, tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This protects your data and is required for notifications on iPhone/iPad.
install.genericInstructions: Open your browser's menu and look for "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen."

storage.title: Storage
storage.persisted: Your data is protected from automatic cleanup.
storage.notPersisted: Your data isn't protected from automatic cleanup yet — installing the app (see above) helps with this.
storage.backupCaveat: This only protects against automatic cleanup. Uninstalling the app, clearing your browser data, or losing this device still deletes everything — back up regularly (below) so you never lose your history.

backup.title: Backup & export
backup.importInvalid: That file doesn't look like a valid {{appName}} backup.
backup.importConfirm: This will replace all data currently on this device with the contents of this backup. This can't be undone.
